summary: Iteration 3 tested the full auth migration (Emergent Google OAuth + per-user isolation + admin/premium roles + rate limiting + Stripe). Backend: 29/29 pytest tests PASS covering (a) public root returns {'message': 'Beautify Yourself & Beyond API'}, (b) /api/auth/me returns 401 without / with bad Bearer, (c) /api/auth/session endpoint exists, validates body (422 on empty), and rejects invalid Emergent tokens with non-2xx (401), (d) /api/auth/logout is idempotent (200 without auth), (e) all content endpoints (GET/POST /journal, /notes, /feedback, /mood, /tasks, /affirmations, /declutter, /stats, /me/subscription, /ai/reset) return 401 without Bearer token, (f) /api/stripe/create-checkout-session returns 401 without auth, (g) all admin endpoints (/admin/stats, /admin/users, /admin/feedback, /admin/moderation-log, DELETE /admin/moderate/...) return 401 without auth, (h) slowapi Limiter is importable and configured on /api/ai/reset via decorator. Frontend: login screen renders cleanly on mobile viewport (375x667) at /login — the DragonflyIcon SVG, brand headline BEAUTIFY / Yourself / AND BEYOND, welcome copy, disclaimer 'wellness companion — not a substitute for licensed medical care', and gold 'G  Continue with Google' TouchableOpacity with testID='google-login-button' all render. Button touch target is 261x51 (>= 44pt). Zero page errors, no LinkingContext / expo-router / red-screen errors. Deep-link guard verified: navigating directly to /journal (unauthenticated) redirects to /login (index.tsx uses <Redirect href='/login' /> when !user). Google OAuth flow cannot be exercised end-to-end without a real Google account, but the /login handler correctly builds https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<login-url> and reads session_id from URL hash/query on return (verified by code review). Only non-blocking noise: a single library warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from safe-area-context / gesture-handler (unchanged from iteration_2).

issues: 'BOSSLADYLISA'S℠' visually renders the ℠ as separate small 'SM' next to the brand — same superscript issue previously flagged for Boss Mode Planner℠ / 143 Life Notes℠ (see iteration_1/2). Non-blocking, brand nit.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Library-originated, non-blocking. Reference: browser console on /login.

action_items: (brand nit, low priority) Replace the literal ℠ character in login title and Stack.Screen headers with a styled superscript <Text> so it doesn't render as adjacent 'SM'.
(cleanup, not blocking) Track the safe-area-context / gesture-handler upgrade to silence 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user correctly guards Bearer parsing, expires_at TZ-normalization, and reads {'_id': 0} projections everywhere — no ObjectId leaks.

First-user auto-admin logic in POST /api/auth/session uses count_documents == 0 which is race-prone under concurrent first sign-ins; fine for a single Google OAuth flow but consider a unique 'seed admin' guard.

Rate-limiter uses get_remote_address which behind an ingress will collapse to a single IP for all users; consider a user-scoped key_func (based on Bearer token) once auth-scoped rate-limits are needed.

authFetch in /app/frontend/src/store/useAuth.ts calls logout() on ANY 401 including the initial /auth/me probe on cold start (loadSession handles that path itself — good). Just note that any legitimate 401 elsewhere silently logs the user out; acceptable UX.

STRIPE_PREMIUM_PRICE_ID is still 'price_premium_placeholder' — /api/stripe/create-checkout-session will 500 for authenticated free users trying to upgrade until a real price_ ID is set. The endpoint correctly detects the placeholder and returns a clear error.
server.py is 743 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit flagged in the review guidelines. Consider splitting auth, stripe, admin, and content routers into modules.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_protection.py (new, replaces old test_beautify_api.py which was auth-less and no longer relevant)
seed_data_creation: None — no protected write path can be exercised without a real Emergent Google session token. First real Google sign-in on the live app will become the auto-admin/premium user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth migration verified. Backend enforces Bearer auth on every protected route; admin/premium role guards return 401 (unauthenticated) before dependency chain reaches the 403/402 role check — so testers cannot distinguish premium-gated from admin-gated purely from unauth requests. To exercise full flow, sign in via https://auth.emergentagent.com in a real browser: the login screen will redirect and, on return, /login parses session_id from the URL hash, POSTs to /api/auth/session, and stores the returned session_token in localStorage (web) / SecureStore (native). Preview URL: https://beautify-yourself.preview.emergentagent.com. Login testID: google-login-button. Home testIDs: home-screen, theme-picker-button, admin-shortcut-button (admin only), logout-button, upgrade-banner (free only), feature-card-{reset|journal|notes|quotes|planner|declutter|affirmations|feedback|support}, disclaimer-link. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_protection.py (parametrized 401 sweep + auth endpoint checks).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. The LinkingContext error reported by the user is confirmed FIXED: /login mounts cleanly with zero page errors and useRouter/Redirect from expo-router work correctly.
